action.objective: Verify a2a4 at full depth as the reserved broad-search suggestion, checking it for tactical refutations before committing.
action.rationale: The broad depth-1 search gave a2a4 an exact 150, the top score, but only at depth 1 with cutoff reached, so it is unproven. Black just played g7g5, extending the pawn chain; the position is a middlegame with no castling rights and no undeveloped minors. I will spend the reserved 2000 nodes on a full-depth 4 single-candidate verification of a2a4, including the mate-safety probes, to obtain exact evidence before any commit.
